messages:
Ava (CEO): Morning — short note for the week. Focus areas: reliability, Private pilot, and unit-economics. I know this is a lot; please read and react with one-line commitments so we can track.

Ava (CEO): 1) Reliability: we need p99 latency & error stability across hosted. Goal: <1% user-facing error rate and p99 under 250ms for baseline workloads over the next 30 days. Ops & Eng: prioritize quick mitigations + a rollback policy for problematic releases. :rotating_light:

Ava (CEO): 2) Redwood Private pilot: legal + sales pilots are lined up. Next week we invite first three customers to the private control plane. Maya/Eng: confirm canary plan and audit logging default. Diego: coordinate customer success materials. :lock:

Ava (CEO): 3) Cost / efficiency: finance asks for a 10% reduction in cost-per-1M-tokens across hosted by quarter end. Short levers: batching, prefix caching, quantization for background models. Sam, can you share runway impact if we hit 10%? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Diego (VP Product): On the Private pilot, I’ll publish a short runbook + customer-facing FAQ by EOD tomorrow. I’ll also add a short checklist for feature-gating what’s enabled in GA vs pilot. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-pilot (draft)

Maya (VP Eng): Reliability: we’ll push the canary config to increase autoscale reserve + shorten cool-downs. Plan to run jittered traffic tests Wed-Thu. I want a runbook review with SRE before invites go out. 

Maya (VP Eng): Also flag: one risky model change is scheduled for next Tuesday — we either delay or gate behind fallback variant. I recommend gating.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Quick metric snapshot from last 24h:

```
last_24h:
  p99_latency_ms: 210
  errors_rate_user_facing: 1.8%
  prefix_cache_hit: 14%
  queued_requests_peak: 430
```

Liam (Head of Reliability): Action items: 1) enable cross-region fallback for EU->US for critical routes, 2) bump reserved capacity on Dedicated for 48h window during canary, 3) SLOs -> runbook link update. I’ll post the runbook PR in #eng-oncall in 30m.

Sam (Head of Finance): If we meet a 10% unit cost reduction, projected burn reduction ~ $1.1M/quarter (conservative). I’ll model scenarios with and without Dedicated commitments. Proposal: fund a short-term quantization sprint (2 eng hires or contractor 6 weeks) — ROI in ~8 weeks.

Sam (Head of Finance): Quick ask: ops/eng, please tag any cost-impacting rollout items in the weekly planning doc so we can include in forecast.

deploy-bot: Canary started: private-vpc-1 -> 3 nodes, build 2026.03.15-rc4. Monitored metrics attached. :rocket:

incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-16-01: brief outage on hosted routing 02:11-02:32 UTC. Root cause: autoscale race condition; mitigated by temporary reserve. Postmortem draft coming to #postmortems.

Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. Two asks: (A) each lead replies in-thread with one concrete commitment (1 line) by EOD today, (B) ops + product schedule a 30m readiness check before customer invites go out. I’ll join if timing aligns. :memo:

Diego (VP Product): Commitment: Publish pilot FAQ + customer checklist by EOD tomorrow. 

Maya (VP Eng): Commitment: Gate the risky model change and run canary with reserved capacity; runbook review scheduled Thu 10:00 UTC. 

Liam (Head of Reliability): Commitment: Enable cross-region fallback and open runbook PR within 2 hours. 

Sam (Head of Finance): Commitment: Deliver cost-scenario slide deck by Friday EOD.

Ava (CEO): Great — appreciate the quick responses. Small wins this week will matter. :thumbsup:
